hook: Use your Mac from Linux, smooth enough for video.
hookText: mardp: an RDP server for macOS

beats.say: mardp is an open-source, BSD-licensed RDP server for macOS, with its own RDP library written from scratch in Go.
Connect from Linux with Remmina or FreeRDP and get your Mac's desktop as H.264 video with sound, smooth enough to watch films.
You need macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon and about fifteen minutes. After five failed logins, that computer must wait, from one minute up to an hour.
